question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Applaud
solution:
Correct Answer: '**Option 4: Denounce'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Applaud' **(ताली बजाना/सराहना करना) means show approval, praise, or give applause. 

 
 
• **For example,:** "The audience applauded the performance."
 
 
 
• **'Denounce'** (निंदा करना), the correct antonym, means condemn openly or publicly. 
 
 
• **For example:** "He denounced the government's actions."
 
 

Therefore, the** correct answer** is** 'Option 4: Denounce'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Commend' **(सराहना करना) often refers to praise officially or publicly.
 
• **'Magnify'** (बड़ा करना) could mean make (something) appear larger than it is, especially with a lens or microscope.
 
• **'Approve' **(स्वीकृति देना) indicates you have a favorable view of something.
